paper: A synthetic oscillatory network of transcriptional regulators
intervention_or_comparison: Constructed a three-repressor cyclic network in Escherichia coli and tracked GFP in single cells
measured_outcome: Noisy multi-hour oscillations transmitted across generations
carrier_relation_supported: Closed cyclic repression can realize sustained oscillation
causal_limitation: Single engineered implementation; no edge-specific necessity test in this paper
manuscript_claim: Synthetic cyclic repression realizes the baseline oscillator signature

paper: Synchronous long-term oscillations in a synthetic gene circuit
intervention_or_comparison: Integrated reporter; removed ASV tags and degradation; added TetR binding-site sponge; compared synchronized and unsynchronized populations
measured_outcome: Period CV and phase drift decreased; phase retained for hundreds of generations; synchronized flask and colony oscillations
carrier_relation_supported: Oscillatory identity survives substantial implementation changes within the cyclic repression class
causal_limitation: Modifications jointly alter kinetics; they do not prove cyclic repression is universally necessary for every oscillator
manuscript_claim: Admissible component and kinetic substitutions preserve the oscillator class

paper: Rapid cell-free forward engineering of novel genetic ring oscillators
intervention_or_comparison: Built and characterized three-, four- and five-gene ring oscillators in cell-free TXTL and cells
measured_outcome: Oscillation periods matched across cell-free and cellular implementations; 95% of five-node cells oscillated up to 72 h
carrier_relation_supported: Ring repression transports across implementation context and ring size
causal_limitation: Transport is demonstrated only for tested architectures and parameter regimes
manuscript_claim: The oscillatory relation class is transportable beyond one molecular realization

paper: Electronic implementation of a repressilator with quorum sensing feedback
intervention_or_comparison: Built an electronic analog and injected additive noise near bifurcations
measured_outcome: Electronic circuit reproduced predicted steady states, limit cycles and noise-sensitive transitions
carrier_relation_supported: Cyclic inhibitory dynamics transport to a non-biochemical substrate
causal_limitation: Analog preserves qualitative dynamics, not biochemical trajectory equivalence
manuscript_claim: Cross-substrate transport supports relational rather than molecular identity

paper: Robust perfect adaptation in bacterial chemotaxis through integral feedback control
intervention_or_comparison: Control-theoretic analysis of the Barkai-Leibler chemotaxis model under parameter and input variation
measured_outcome: Output returns to prestimulus value despite persistent input and parameter changes
carrier_relation_supported: Persistent error integration is the structural carrier of robust perfect adaptation
causal_limitation: Necessity result relies on model structure and local linearization arguments; not a new wet-lab perturbation
manuscript_claim: Integral feedback supplies exact domain evidence for the RPA UMI

paper: Antithetic Integral Feedback Ensures Robust Perfect Adaptation in Noisy Biomolecular Networks
intervention_or_comparison: Introduced and analyzed sequestration-based antithetic feedback in stochastic reaction networks
measured_outcome: Population and time averages robustly adapt to reference under broad plant uncertainty
carrier_relation_supported: Difference of two controller species integrates output error
causal_limitation: Ideal theory is modified by dilution, leak and saturation in physical implementations
manuscript_claim: Antithetic realization is a substitution of the same internal-model relation class

paper: A universal biomolecular integral feedback controller for robust perfect adaptation
intervention_or_comparison: Engineered closed-loop and open-loop bacterial circuits; perturbed with aTc and HSL; tested growth-rate control
measured_outcome: Closed loop adapted and was tunable under environmental and network perturbations
carrier_relation_supported: Sensor-integrator-actuator closure realizes RPA in living cells
causal_limitation: Nonideal dilution, actuator saturation and negative disturbances introduce steady-state error
manuscript_claim: Living-cell intervention supports physical realization of the RPA carrier

paper: In vitro implementation of robust gene regulation in a synthetic biomolecular integral controller
intervention_or_comparison: Compared sequestration closed loop with an open-loop mSA replacement; varied and stepped input DNA concentration
measured_outcome: Closed-loop output production rate tracked the reference and rejected specified disturbances; open loop was nonlinear
carrier_relation_supported: Protein sequestration implements persistent error integration and corrective feedback
causal_limitation: Tracking depends on promoter availability and saturates outside the tested operating range
manuscript_claim: A cell-free substrate transports the RPA relation class

paper: A genetic mammalian proportional-integral feedback control circuit for robust and precise gene regulation
intervention_or_comparison: Perturbed target degradation and network structure; compared integral and proportional-integral motifs
measured_outcome: Maintained tunable expression, achieved robust perfect adaptation and reduced variance and burden effects
carrier_relation_supported: Antithetic integral closure transports to mammalian cells and can be refined by proportional feedback
causal_limitation: Paper demonstrates sufficiency in one mammalian architecture; universality follows from companion theory, not this experiment alone
manuscript_claim: Mammalian implementation strengthens cross-substrate RPA transport

paper: Construction of a genetic toggle switch in Escherichia coli
intervention_or_comparison: Applied transient IPTG, aTc and temperature perturbations; changed RBS strengths; compared bistable and monostable constructs
measured_outcome: Cells switched between stable high and low states and retained state after inducer withdrawal; some variants lost bistability
carrier_relation_supported: Mutual regenerative repression plus nonlinear gain and write input realizes bounded memory
causal_limitation: Bistability depends on quantitative promoter and repressor balance; topology alone is insufficient
manuscript_claim: Genetic toggle evidence supports the writable-memory carrier

paper: An engineered epigenetic transgene switch in mammalian cells
intervention_or_comparison: Used transient erythromycin or pristinamycin to set alternate states; withdrew drugs; repeatedly switched; implanted encapsulated cells in mice
measured_outcome: High and low expression states persisted for weeks and remained reversibly switchable
carrier_relation_supported: Regenerative mutual repression and transient write signals transport to mammalian cells
causal_limitation: One engineered architecture with fitted asymmetry parameters; minimality is not established by this paper alone
manuscript_claim: Mammalian transport supports implementation invariance of writable bistability

paper: Construction of an in vitro bistable circuit from synthetic transcriptional switches
intervention_or_comparison: Wired two RNA-regulated transcriptional switches; varied RNAP and RNase H activities; measured transfer curves, phase plane and bifurcation diagram
measured_outcome: Observed adjustable thresholds and bistable memory consistent with a quantitative model
carrier_relation_supported: Regeneration and saturation can be implemented in a stripped-down cell-free biochemical network
causal_limitation: Batch-specific parameters and template-loss corrections limit claims of universal quantitative invariance
manuscript_claim: Cell-free substitution preserves the bistable relation class

paper: Direct experimental evidence for kinetic proofreading in amino acylation of tRNAIle
intervention_or_comparison: Compared ATP hydrolysis per charged tRNA for correct isoleucine and incorrect valine; used Tu-GTP to suppress deacylation
measured_outcome: Approximately 1.5 ATP per correct charging versus about 270 ATP per incorrect charging; inferred ~180-fold error reduction
carrier_relation_supported: Energy-consuming reject/reset cycles amplify specificity beyond one equilibrium recognition step
causal_limitation: Stoichiometry supports proofreading but does not uniquely identify every microscopic intermediate
manuscript_claim: Direct biochemical evidence supports the proofreading carrier

paper: Optogenetic control shows that kinetic proofreading regulates the activity of the T cell receptor
intervention_or_comparison: Used PhyB optogenetics to vary ligand-TCR binding duration while controlling interaction interface; modeled downstream activation
measured_outcome: Binding half-life was decisive for TCR signaling and strongly supported a positive proofreading delay
carrier_relation_supported: Sequential progression conditioned on dwell time implements multistep discrimination
causal_limitation: Causal isolation depends on the optogenetic model and fitted reaction scheme; it does not prove one unique molecular timer
manuscript_claim: Optogenetic perturbation supplies relation-specific evidence for kinetic proofreading

paper: Light-based tuning of ligand half-life supports kinetic proofreading model of T cell signaling
intervention_or_comparison: Varied blue-light-controlled LOV2-CAR binding half-life and ligand concentration to decouple half-life from occupancy
measured_outcome: DAG signaling tracked binding half-life better than occupancy; discrimination occurred between ZAP70 recruitment and DAG production
carrier_relation_supported: Multistep temporal progression rather than occupancy alone carries discrimination
causal_limitation: Rebinding and model assumptions can affect inferred proofreading depth; steady illumination defines the jurisdiction
manuscript_claim: Independent optogenetic implementation transports the proofreading carrier

paper: Kinetic Proofreading Can Enhance Specificity in a Nonenzymatic DNA Strand Displacement Network
intervention_or_comparison: Engineered a nonenzymatic strand-displacement proofreading network and compared specificity with non-proofreading recognition
measured_outcome: Proofreading architecture enhanced discrimination in a synthetic chemical substrate
carrier_relation_supported: Driven multistep reject/reset relation transports beyond enzymes and receptors
causal_limitation: Synthetic chemistry realizes the class under designed fuel and leak conditions
manuscript_claim: Cross-substrate transport strengthens class-level proofreading identity

paper: Testing Turing's theory of morphogenesis in chemical cells
intervention_or_comparison: Created BZ-reactant droplets in circular and hexagonal arrays and compared emergent structures across geometries
measured_outcome: Observed five of six predicted structures and a stationary chemically selected wavelength; a seventh structure required heterogeneity
carrier_relation_supported: Reaction-transport coupling can destabilize homogeneous chemistry and select finite spatial scales
causal_limitation: Geometry-dependent extra structure shows that the original homogeneous theory is not invariant across all implementations
manuscript_claim: Chemical-cell experiment supports the finite-k carrier with explicit jurisdiction

paper: Stochastic Turing patterns in a synthetic bacterial population
intervention_or_comparison: Engineered an activator-inhibitor bacterial circuit that destabilized a homogeneous lawn; tuned circuit parameters
measured_outcome: Produced disordered large-scale patterns whose spatial correlations matched stochastic Turing theory
carrier_relation_supported: Stochastic activator-inhibitor reaction and differential transport realize a finite-k patterning class
causal_limitation: Pattern correlation supports the mechanism but does not by itself prove uniqueness against every alternative spatial process
manuscript_claim: Synthetic population supplies direct biological Turing evidence

paper: A three-node Turing gene circuit forms periodic spatial patterns in bacteria
intervention_or_comparison: Engineered a non-classical three-node reaction-diffusion circuit and fitted a PDE model to experimental colonies
measured_outcome: Reproducibly generated stationary concentric periodic stripes in growing E. coli colonies with improved parametric robustness
carrier_relation_supported: A distinct network topology transports the finite-wavenumber instability class
causal_limitation: Model fitting locates a Turing regime but the paper does not establish minimality relative to every alternative circuit
manuscript_claim: Recent implementation strengthens substitution and transport evidence

paper: A unified design space of synthetic stripe-forming networks
intervention_or_comparison: Enumerated and built stripe-forming circuits driven by an externally supplied arabinose gradient; altered dose-response to create anti-stripes
measured_outcome: Multiple mechanisms produced stripe or anti-stripe expression profiles
carrier_relation_supported: Shows that stripe phenotype does not imply spontaneous finite-k instability
causal_limitation: This is a deliberate mechanistic decoy, not a failed biological system
manuscript_claim: Externally instructed stripes are negative for the strict Turing signature

paper: Emergence of symbiosis in peptide self-replication through a hypercyclic network
intervention_or_comparison: Seeded reactions with each replicator, simplified reaction mixtures and disrupted interactions with guanidinium hydrochloride
measured_outcome: Each peptide catalyzed itself and the other; seeding one enhanced production of both
carrier_relation_supported: Mutual cross-catalysis closes collective replication rather than independent competition
causal_limitation: Sequence selectivity is strong; transport to arbitrary peptide variants is not implied
manuscript_claim: Peptide experiment supports collective autocatalytic closure

paper: Spontaneous formation of autocatalytic sets with self-replicating inorganic metal oxide clusters
intervention_or_comparison: Started from simple inorganic salts and tracked self-assembly and templated cluster formation
measured_outcome: Observed autocatalytic sets of replicating inorganic clusters that template larger structures
carrier_relation_supported: Autocatalytic closure transports to a non-organic chemical substrate
causal_limitation: System establishes autocatalysis and molecular recognition; minimal RAF decomposition is not fully identical to the paper's experimental language
manuscript_claim: Inorganic transport supports relation-class rather than molecular identity

paper: Autocatalytic, bistable, oscillatory networks of biologically relevant organic reactions
intervention_or_comparison: Varied flow-space velocity and maleimide concentration in CSTRs; crossed bifurcations
measured_outcome: Observed autocatalysis, bistability, damped and sustained oscillations with hysteresis
carrier_relation_supported: Autocatalysis plus trigger and inhibitory removal relations generate closed nonlinear regimes
causal_limitation: This paper does not prove a minimal RAF set or invariance across chemistries
manuscript_claim: Provides intervention-rich support for autocatalytic relational organization

paper: Quorum sensing integrates environmental cues, cell density and cell history to control bacterial competence
intervention_or_comparison: Varied pH, antibiotics, inoculation density, CSP concentration and preculture history; combined experiments with a bistable model
measured_outcome: Competence depended jointly on density, environment and history; model predicted a bistable regime
carrier_relation_supported: Extracellular signal, positive feedback, environmental gating and history jointly shape competence
causal_limitation: Several coupled carriers remain plausible and initial conditions are constitutive; current evidence does not isolate one inclusion-minimal class
manuscript_claim: Evidence justifies ABSTAIN rather than a unique quorum-sensing UMI

paper: Tunability and noise dependence in differentiation dynamics
intervention_or_comparison: Changed competence-circuit parameters and architecture and experimentally reduced global noise
measured_outcome: Tuned initiation frequency and episode duration; accessed different regimes including oscillation
carrier_relation_supported: Positive feedback, noise and timing jointly control state transitions
causal_limitation: Multiple parameters independently control phenotype; no unique minimal carrier is isolated
manuscript_claim: Reinforces causal nonuniqueness in the competence abstention case
